title: New Order
description: This is the representation of the order that was provided by a food ordering app.

origin.description: Contains information about the food ordering partner that created the order.

orderId.description: An identifier that has been generated by the origin. This can be used for reconciliation of orders in the app partner’s system.

orderReference.description: Reference for the order. You should use it to facilitate the communication between the merchant and the eater during fulfillment by providing a short code that allows the order to be easily identifiable.

locationId.description: The id of the location as specified by the Tyro Connect system.

status.description: The current status of the order. When created, order status must be `CREATED` or `ACCEPTED`.

notes.description: A free text field with instructions from the customer to the merchant.

items.description: A list of all the items in the order.

table.description: This object is optional, and if present will only have information about table and section.

customers.description: The object only has a single field firstName.

discounts.description: Each entry in the discounts array will apply to the whole order and is included in the order total value.

surcharges.description: Each entry in the surcharges array will apply to the whole order and is included in the order total value.

total.description: The order total is calculated as order.total = (item.unitPrice + item.modifiersTotal - item.discounts) * item.quantity + order.surcharges - order.discounts + order.tip. Please note that TyroConnect does not enforce this calculation to allow flexibility while creating an order.

tip.description: This value will apply to the whole order and is included in the order total value.

fulfilment.description: Details about how the customers expect to receive the order.

type.description: Type of fulfilment the customer expects

paymentStatus.description: Current payment status of the order. Can be either `OPEN` or `CLOSED`. `OPEN` payment status is only applicable for orders with fulfilment type of `DINE_IN`.

amount.description: This is the amount in smallest currency unit. e.g 12520 (in cents) is $125.20
This is the amount in smallest currency unit. e.g 12520 (in cents) is $125.20

description.description: A description of what this amount of money represents

order-item.title: Order Item
order-item.description: This object represents an item within a food order.

id.description:
An id unique to the order, representing the item within the overall order.
order, i.e. 2 of the same items will have unique ids.

unitPrice.description: The basic price of a single item in cents excluding discounts (if any).

discounts.title: Money with Itemisation
discounts.description: Each entry in the discounts array will apply to each single item - it represents unit discounts (eg. if the quantity of this object is defined as 2 and the discounts array contains one $1 entry, each of the 2 items should be discounted by $1). item.total = (item.unitPrice + item.modifiersTotal - item.discounts) * item.quantity

modifiers.description: A list of modifications to be made to the parent item. Each entry in this array will apply to each single item - it represents unit modifiers (eg. if the quantity of this object is defined as 2 and the modifiers array contains one $1 entry, each of the 2 items should be modified by $1). item.total = (item.unitPrice + item.modifiersTotal - item.discounts) * item.quantity'

allergens.description: Allergens that need to be removed from the parent item.

sku.description: Id of the item that is aligned with the ID of the item in the POS.

description.description: A human readable description of the item that can be used to resolve mismatches between the app and the POS.

quantity.description: The number of units of this item required to fulfil the order. Please note that items with different modifiers or surcharges should be split into separate item objects.

notes.description: An instruction or message about this order item.
